label: O.2.48
description: 26 lines to a page. The paper is very thick and soft and much worn at the edges, especially in the middle of the volume.

metadata.label: Provenance
metadata.value: Part of the Gale collection, given to T.C.C. by Roger Gale in 1738. K. 15. No. 385. Possibly German.

metadata.label: Collation
metadata.value: In quires of twelve, with not a few mutilations. The collation is almost impossible on account of the character and condition of the paper.
